limits.sandbox: CPU-only Docker python@c61cffc3, no network, 256 MB, 1 CPU, 10 s per grade

scheduling.placement: agent j of case c on replica/grader host (c+j)%4
scheduling.concurrency_note: each arm alone on the fleet: 20 client requests per node <= 25

serving.launch: Inkling-2-Mini-1x-DGX-Spark v2.9.2 (a29380b; scripts/launch.sh sha 9428eb69...) `scripts/launch.sh up` with release defaults (SPEC=dflash2, drafter incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2@4f9088ea, MEM_FRACTION 0.88, CTX 262144, memguard 3.5 GiB) and only the swarm wiring env NAME=swarm-recipe PORT=30000 HOST=127.0.0.1 SERVED=inkling; the swarm serving default since 2026-11-25 (coding-v29-r2-v1: -20 % wall, -20 % Wh at equal quality)

selection: the first proposal in TIME order that passes ALL feedback cases ends the case: other agents of the case are terminated, queued ones never start; solved if it passes ALL holdout cases
resume_rule: As in earlier coding plans: on an operational fault the runner stops admissions; the same arm is continued only for unfinished cases with the same seeds and documented as an amendment.
frozen_note: Frozen before any call with seeds 25-27 on coding-hard-v1.
question: Generic AoT on coding (code_aot) vs plain coding agents (code_xl) under R2, same budget, protocol-only prompts.
execution: Each arm alone on the fleet via inkling/coding_arms.py (fresh admission with shim sha and mem fraction 0.75, prefix-cache flush, server counters, idle wait, GPU energy), 20 agents per node, in the order S, R4, R2.

primary_outcomes.tokens: Server-counted generated tokens per case, R4 and R2 vs S.
primary_outcomes.accuracy: Solved/72 per arm, paired two-sided exact sign tests vs S (run-to-run noise of a few cases applies).
primary_outcomes.wall: Arm wall time and median / p90 case stop time.

decision_rule: AoT is adopted if A solved >= P solved + 3, A wrong <= P wrong, A server tokens <= 1.10 x P (complete pairing).
secondary_outcomes: GPU energy per solved case; agents started per case; cases with replacement; never-started agents; wrong answers (passed public tests, failed holdout).
exclusions: None; all 72 cases of each arm count.
arm: R2: early stop, 2 in flight, every agent ending without a passing proposal is replaced, up to 8
